parsed_json.up: Return approved drugs with a COVID-19 indication. Select ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication CURIE, indication label, and maximum phase for indication. Source from molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures. Filter for max_phase_for_ind equal to 4 and indication label equal to 'COVID-19'. Sort by ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication CURIE, indication label, and maximum phase for indication in ascending order.
